segments.title: China Trade Talks, EU Framework Deal, Trump Golf & Cheating Scandal
segments.notes: Case covers US-China tariff truce talks in Stockholm, EU 15% tariff framework deal announced at Trump's Scotland golf course, Trump golfing to musical soundtrack (Uptown Girl, Memory, Bridge Over Troubled Water) while protesters gather, and alleged golf cheating clip.

segments.title: Trailer Monday: Eyes of Wakanda, Avatar: The First Firebender, Peacemaker S2, Aztec Batman
segments.notes: Trent reviews animated series trailer Eyes of Wakanda, Avatar franchise trailer with returning whales and characters, Peacemaker Season 2 multiverse trailer, and Aztec Batman animated film with mixed reactions to animation style.

segments.title: Alien Sexology: Joe Rogan on Mantis Harems & 1957 Brazilian Abduction Case
segments.notes: Case plays Joe Rogan clip on alien species (Greys, tall whites, Nordics, mantids), then a Mass Effect lore video about Antonio Villas-Boas' 1957 alien abduction and sexual encounter with a female humanoid.

segments.title: Hot Dog vs Sandwich Debate with The Devil
segments.notes: The Devil moderates Munch (pro-sandwich) and Crum (anti-sandwich) on whether a hot dog is a sandwich; Devil reveals Crum lost once and must lose two more times to extract someone from hell; Crum remains largely non-verbal.

segments.title: Hate Sock Bit: Eleanor Rigby Lyrics Dispute
segments.notes: Case and Hate Sock argue over Beatles' Eleanor Rigby chorus lyrics ('all the lonely people' vs 'all the lovely people'); Intern and Pepito confirm correct lyrics; Case refuses to concede.

segments.title: Raid to Oveli
segments.notes: Case raids Oveli's channel with Eleanor Rigby trap beat playing.

characters.name: Case Blackwell
characters.notes: Anchored news desk covering China/EU trade deals and Trump golf coverage; hosted Trent at the Movies and alien segment; moderated Munch & Crum debate; argued with Hate Sock over Beatles lyrics.

characters.name: Pepito
characters.notes: executive producer. Delivered cold open sign-on; confirmed Eleanor Rigby lyrics during Hate Sock bit; refused to fix end credits.

characters.name: Liliana
characters.notes: desk partner. Co-anchored news desk; bantered with Case on hair, tariffs, Trump golf music, and Beatles knowledge.

characters.name: Kendelle
characters.notes: in-studio contributor. Walked through studio to collect food Case ordered; discussed smart ring stress tracking from New York shoot week.

characters.name: Trent
characters.notes: correspondent. Hosted trailer segment covering Eyes of Wakanda, Avatar, Peacemaker S2, and Aztec Batman.

characters.name: Munch (Ralph Munchcut)
characters.notes: debate analyst. Argued hot dog IS a sandwich in existential nihilistic terms; pressed Devil for Crum's win updates.

characters.name: Crum (Leonard Crum)
characters.notes: debate analyst. Argued hot dog is NOT a sandwich; largely non-verbal; Devil stated Crum lost one of three required losses to extract someone from hell.

characters.name: The Devil
characters.notes: debate moderator. Moderated hot dog debate; revealed Crum's hell gambling liability (must lose 3x); claimed hell may exist in Trump's penis tip.

characters.name: Hate Sock
characters.notes: puppet bit character. Argued with Case over Eleanor Rigby lyrics; claimed 'all the lovely people' is correct chorus.

characters.name: Intern
characters.notes: studio staff. Confirmed correct Eleanor Rigby lyrics ('all the lonely people') during Hate Sock bit.

episode_summary: Case Blackwell anchors a trade-heavy news block covering US-China tariff truce talks in Stockholm and the EU's 15% framework deal announced at Trump's Scottish golf resort, where Trump golfed to showtunes while protesters gathered. Trent reviews trailers for Eyes of Wakanda, Avatar: The First Firebender, Peacemaker Season 2, and Aztec Batman. Case then pivots to alien sexuality via Joe Rogan and a 1957 Brazilian abduction case. The Devil moderates a Munch & Crum debate on whether a hot dog is a sandwich, revealing Crum must lose two more debates to satisfy a hellish gambling debt. The broadcast closes with a Hate Sock bit disputing Eleanor Rigby lyrics and a raid to Oveli.
